description: Real responses of the student demo flow, recorded on 2026-11-11 against a production build (npm run start:prod, NODE_ENV=production) of this API with the demo seed data. Use them as response examples; ids, dates and AI-written texts will differ in your own runs.
student: Demo student of class 7-A (seed:mvp). Login is not included; send Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> from POST /api/auth/login.
flow: health -> today -> subjects -> topic page -> finish-lesson (demo) -> quiz start -> wrong answer -> 2 hints -> 9 more answers -> submit (60%) -> mistake review -> confirmation question (wrong, then right) -> study chat with a selected paragraph -> practice quiz (5 right) -> Tushuntir checkpoint: Sardor opens -> weak typed answer -> follow-up -> wrong typed answer (not_yet, next try) -> voice answer (passed) -> checkpoint status -> mastery -> history -> subjects
notes: Each step: label, request, body (JSON requests), status, ms (time to the response) and response.
The voice answer was a multipart upload (field audio) of an ogg/opus recording synthesized from voiceAnswerScript with a female Uzbek voice; response.transcript is what speech-to-text heard.
audioUrl values are relative to the API origin (e.g. https://<api>/uploads/tts/<hash>.mp3).
Correct answers were read from the database by the test script only to drive the run; the API never sends them before submit.
voiceAnswerScript: Sardor, sen adashding. Ko'phad bu birhadlarning yig'indisi, birhadlar esa uning hadlari deyiladi. O'xshash hadlarni qo'shganda faqat koeffitsiyentlar qo'shiladi, harfiy qism o'zgarmaydi. Masalan, uch x plyus ikki x besh x bo'ladi. Agar qavs oldida minus tursa, qavsni ochganda ichidagi har bir hadning ishorasi o'zgaradi, faqat birinchisining emas. Shuning uchun bir ko'phaddan ikkinchisini ayirganda ayriluvchi ko'phadning hamma hadlari ishorasini o'zgartiramiz. Masalan, besh a dan, qavs ichida ikki a minus uch ni ayirsak, uch a plyus uch chiqadi. Oxirida javobni tekshirish uchun a o'rniga bir sonni qo'yib ko'ramiz.

response.summary: Ko'phad birhadlarning yig'indisidir, o'xshash hadlar esa koeffitsiyentlarini qo'shib ixchamlanadi. Qavs oldida plyus bo'lsa, ishoralar o'zgarmaydi; minus bo'lsa, qavs ichidagi har bir hadning ishorasi o'zgaradi. Ko'phadlarni qo'shish va ayirish uchun qavslar ochiladi va o'xshash hadlar ixchamlanadi.
keyIdeas: Ko'phad birhadlar yig'indisi; birhadlar uning hadlari deyiladi.
O'xshash hadlarni ixchamlashda koeffitsiyentlar qo'shiladi, harfiy qism o'zgarmaydi.
Qavs oldida minus bo'lsa, qavs ichidagi har bir hadning ishorasi o'zgaradi.
Ko'phadlarni ayirishda ayriluvchi ko'phadning barcha hadlari ishorasi o'zgaradi.
Natijani o'zgaruvchiga son qo'yib tekshirish mumkin.

paragraphs.content: Bir nechta birhadning yig'indisi ko'phad deyiladi. Ko'phadni tashkil etgan birhadlar uning hadlari deyiladi. Masalan, 3x^2 - 5x + 2 ko'phadning hadlari: 3x^2, -5x va 2. Ikki hadli ko'phad ikkihad, uch hadli ko'phad esa uchhad deb ham ataladi.
O'xshash hadlarni ixchamlash uchun ularning koeffitsiyentlari qo'shiladi, harfiy qismi esa o'zgarmaydi. Masalan, 4a + 7b - a + 2b = (4 - 1)a + (7 + 2)b = 3a + 9b.

Barcha hadlari standart shakldagi birhadlar bo'lgan va o'xshash hadlari ixchamlangan ko'phad standart shakldagi ko'phad deyiladi. Standart shakldagi ko'phadning darajasi uning hadlari darajalarining eng kattasiga teng. Masalan, 3x^2 - 5x + 2 ko'phadning darajasi 2.

Qavslarni ochish qoidalari:
- Qavs oldida plyus ishorasi tursa, qavs ichidagi hadlarning ishorasi o'zgarmaydi: a + (b - c) = a + b - c.
- Qavs oldida minus ishorasi tursa, qavs ichidagi har bir hadning ishorasi qarama-qarshisiga o'zgaradi: a - (b - c) = a - b + c.
Ko'phadlarni qo'shish uchun qavslar ochiladi va o'xshash hadlar ixchamlanadi.
Ko'phadlarni ayirishda ayriluvchi ko'phad qavsga olinadi. Qavs oldidagi minus tufayli uning barcha hadlarining ishorasi o'zgaradi.
Eng ko'p uchraydigan xato: minus ishorasini faqat birinchi hadga qo'llash. 5a^2 - 2a + 7 - 3a^2 - 4a + 1 deb yozish noto'g'ri, chunki -4a va +1 ning ishoralari ham o'zgarishi kerak edi.

Tekshirish usuli: o'zgaruvchi o'rniga biror son, masalan a = 1, qo'yib ko'ring. Boshlang'ich ifoda: (5 - 2 + 7) - (3 - 4 + 1) = 10 - 0 = 10. Natija: 2 + 2 + 6 = 10. Qiymatlar teng chiqdi, demak shakl almashtirishda xato bo'lmagan bo'lishi mumkin.
